{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicates based on patient_id, keeping the first occurrence
# (since sample_seq is ordered, first should be earliest)
df_clean = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check the new shape
print("Original shape:", df.shape)
print("Cleaned shape:", df_clean.shape)

# Check the distribution of sites after cleaning
print("Site distribution after cleaning:\n", df_clean['site'].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of arms after cleaning
print("Arm distribution after cleaning:\n", df_clean['arm'].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of severity after cleaning
print("Severity distribution after cleaning:\n", df_clean['severity'].value_counts())"}
